params.body:
This pairs with the gentells-pipeline PR that makes owners people and groups on the team.

**Deliveries**
- Every owner field is now a picker: the groups first, then the people on the team by name. This covers both Who writes which sector and the owner on each read.
- The empty choice says what happens without a pick: "Everyone else" on a sector, "Nobody: whoever takes it up" on Everyone else, and "<name>, by sector" on a read.
- An owner who has left the team shows as "No longer on the team", with "Pick somebody" in red under the read.
- A read for you, directly or through your group, says "For you", and a group read gets a **Take it up** button that makes it yours by name. Others see "Waiting for <name>".
- The summary line counts the reads that are yours: "2 open, 1 late, 1 for you."

**Accounts**
- A new **Groups** section under Team: a name per group, the team members as toggles, Add a group, Remove, and Save the groups (saved as a whole).

Tests: `e2e/deliveries.spec.js` (pickers, take-up, a departed owner), `e2e/accounts.spec.js` (a new test that makes and saves a group) and `e2e/header.spec.js` pass (10 of 10). ESLint is clean on the changed files.
params.title: Pick owners from the team, and make groups on Accounts
